prompt.alinti: These animated line drawings are going viral right now, and a designer just dropped 27 of them for free. You can even build your own. He made a skill that works in any of your favorite AI agents. Put them in a bento grid, a hero, a pricing card, and the whole site looks like a studio made it. It's called Hairline, isometric figures that move with your cursor, ready to paste into any app or site. I asked it for a 3D matplotlib surface and got this. Zero dependencies, about 50 kilobytes, and it's MIT, so it can go in a paid product.

yontem.ne: AI agentler için isometric çizimler üreten bir skill/aracın tanıtımı ve kullanımı.
